response.sql: WITH country_averages AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId), above_overall AS (SELECT ca.avg_wins FROM country_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.avg_wins), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM above_overall) SELECT AVG(a.avg_wins) AS mean_country_average_wins, AVG(a.avg_wins - o.avg_wins) AS mean_excess_over_overall, AVG(a.avg_wins - g.avg_wins) AS mean_excess_over_above_average_group FROM above_overall AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o CROSS JOIN group_average AS g WHERE a.avg_wins > g.avg_wins;
